Pencil decision cost `C_pencil` (Task 1.2, ruling D6), measured by `tools.pipeline_pencil_cost`: every `pipeline` gate case, one case at a time, each of 3 generations in a fresh process; the table reports the low median of each clock. `decide_s` (`C_pencil`) sums the wall clock of every `TangentPencil.build`, `RampOut.build` and `RampOut.next_member` call, each counted on its own: one build of each and one `generate.enter_first_cut` per generation, and one `RampOut.next_member` per emitted member plus the root's, or the task fails. `first_cut_s` sums `generate.enter_first_cut` (helix, ramp-out emission and root loop) and contains `decide_s`; `generation_s` is the whole instrumented generator call, not the uninstrumented timing median. The wrappers only time: the ops digest equals the uninstrumented digest of the same case in `benchmarks/results/pipeline_timing.json` (SHA-256 `f480ef3917f7c27bf1bd11e85584353b485cc40a4d0ebaa4a728e0cf145988e3`), or the task fails. Seconds are wall clock on the machine that ran the task and are valid for the Task 1.2 time gate only beside a `pipeline-timing` run of the same session. Load averages (1 / 5 / 15 minutes) are read before each case's first run and after its last.

**INDICATIVE**: measured without the quiet-machine check (highest recorded 1-minute load 187.25); these seconds yield no time-gate verdict.
